itineraries.title: Bali & Nusa Penida Island Escape
itineraries.overview: An exclusive bespoke tropical getaway crafted for Priya Sharma & Family. Featuring luxury boutique pool villas, scenic Nusa Penida island speedboat transfers, private chauffeur throughout Bali, and curated cafe hopping and cultural tours.
highlights: Private 4★ Pool Villa Stay in Seminyak & Ubud
Exclusive Speedboat to Nusa Penida (Kelingking Cliff & Broken Beach)
Sunrise Mount Batur View & Floating Breakfast in Villa
Uluwatu Cliff Sunset & Traditional Kecak Dance Show
Dedicated Chauffeur & Private AC MPV throughout Bali

hotels.roomType: Deluxe One-Bedroom Pool Villa with Breakfast

transport.vehicleType: Private AC Toyota Innova / Ertiga with Chauffeur
includedFeatures: Fuel, Parking, Tolls & Intercity Transfers included

Private island transfers in Nusa Penida
transport.note: Driver will be available at your disposal for 10 hours daily for sightseeing.

days.title: Arrival in Bali — Seminyak Check-in & Echo Beach Sunset
days.description: Warm Balinese welcome at Denpasar Airport with flower garland. Private transfer to your luxury villa in Seminyak. Unwind by your private pool and head out to Echo Beach for a stunning sunset and welcome dinner at La Brisa beach club.

days.title: South Bali Highlights — Uluwatu Temple & Kecak Fire Dance
days.description: Morning leisure and floating breakfast in your villa. Afternoon visit to dramatic Uluwatu Cliff Temple overlooking the Indian Ocean. Witness the world-famous Kecak Fire Dance at sunset, followed by a romantic candlelit seafood dinner at Jimbaran Bay.

days.title: Full Day Nusa Penida Island Expedition
days.description: Board the fast boat to Nusa Penida. Visit the iconic T-Rex shaped Kelingking Beach cliff viewpoint, marvel at Broken Beach natural rock bridge, and dip your toes at Angel’s Billabong natural infinity pool. Return to Seminyak by evening.

days.title: Transfer to Ubud — Tegenungan Waterfall & Bali Swing
days.description: Check out and drive inland towards cultural Ubud. Stop at Tegenungan Waterfall for scenic photography, visit an organic Balinese Luwak Coffee plantation, and experience the world-renowned Bali Jungle Swing overlooking lush emerald rice paddies.

days.title: Mount Batur Volcano View, Hot Springs & Ubud Palace Crawl
days.description: Early scenic drive to Kintamani overlooking Mount Batur active volcano and Lake Batur. Relax in the natural volcanic hot springs. Afternoon return to Ubud center to explore Ubud Art Market, Ubud Palace, and chic bohemian cafes.

days.title: Souvenir Shopping & Airport Departure with Sweet Memories
days.description: Enjoy a gourmet breakfast at the resort. Free time for last-minute souvenir shopping at Krisna Oleh Oleh. Private chauffeur transfer to Denpasar Airport for your onward flight home with everlasting memories of Bali.

itineraries.title: MEGHALAYA
itineraries.subtitle: BACKPACKING
itineraries.overview: Explore the Abode of Clouds with Travel Tribes. From crystal clear waters of Dawki and the majestic Nohkalikai Falls to the living root bridges of Nongriat and peaceful canyon sunsets.
highlights: Visit Umiam Lake for scenic views and a peaceful boat ride.
Explore the Don Bosco Museum, a hub of Northeast culture.
Stroll through Lady Hydari Park and Ward’s Lake in Shillong.
Witness the stunning Laitlum Canyons, known as the “end of the world.”
Stop at Elephant Falls, one of Shillong’s iconic spots.
Admire panoramic views from Mawkdok Dympep Valley.
Discover the mysterious Arwah Caves and Garden of Caves.
Visit Wah-Kaba Falls and Mawsmai Caves for raw nature.
Marvel at Nohkalikai Falls, India’s tallest plunge waterfall.
Admire the grandeur of Seven Sisters Falls in Cherrapunji.
Trek to the Nongriat Double Decker Root Bridge and Rainbow Falls.
Enjoy the surreal beauty of the Blue Lagoons.
Stay in riverside camps at Dawki, famous for its clear water.
Enjoy a boat ride on the Umngot River at Shnongpdeng.
Visit Mawlynnong Village, Asia’s cleanest village.
Experience the beauty of Phe Phe Waterfall and Krang Suri Falls.
Stop by the India-Bangladesh Border for a unique viewpoint.
End the trip with blessings at Maa Kamakhya Temple in Guwahati.

days.title: Arrival in Guwahati Transfer to Shillong
days.briefRoute: ARRIVAL IN GUWAHATI | TRANSFER TO SHILLONG VIA UMIAM LAKE
points: Arrive at Guwahati Airport before 11:00 AM.
Our representative will meet and greet you at the airport.
The group will depart for Shillong at 12:00 PM.
Enjoy a scenic 4-hour drive from Guwahati to Shillong.
On the way, stop at the beautiful Umiam Lake (Barapani) and capture its stunning views.
Arrive in Shillong and check in to the hotel.
In the evening, explore Police Bazaar.
Return to the hotel and enjoy an overnight stay in Shillong.

days.title: Shillong – Laitlum Canyons – Krang Suri – Phe Phe Falls – Dawki
days.briefRoute: SHILLONG TO CHERRAPUNJI | EXPLORING ELEPHANT FALLS, LAITLUM CANYONS, WEI SAWDONG WATERFALL, MAWSMAI CAVES
points: Enjoy a delicious breakfast at the hotel.
Check out and proceed towards Dawki/Shnongpdeng.
Visit the beautiful Laitlum Canyons.
Explore the stunning Krang Suri Waterfall.
Visit the scenic Phe Phe Falls.
Continue your journey towards Dawki/Shnongpdeng.
Check in to the campsite/homestay.
Enjoy the evening at leisure.
Overnight stay at Dawki/Shnongpdeng.

days.title: Dawki / Shnongpdeng – Mawlynnong – Cherrapunjee
days.briefRoute: CHERRAPUNJI SIGHTSEEING | NOHKALIKAI FALLS, SEVEN SISTERS FALLS & NONGRIAT ROOT BRIDGE
points: Enjoy breakfast and check out from your stay.
Proceed towards Mawlynnong Village, known as one of the cleanest villages in Asia.
Visit the famous Bamboo Sky Walk and Single Decker Living Root Bridge.
Head to the beautiful Dawki River, where you can enjoy adventure activities and boating at your own cost.
Visit the Indo-Bangladesh Border.
Later, proceed towards Cherrapunjee.
Check in to your stay and relax.
Overnight stay in Cherrapunjee.

days.title: Cherrapunjee – Double Decker Living Root Bridge – Blue Lagoon
days.briefRoute: CHERRAPUNJI TO DAWKI VIA MAWLYNNONG | UMNGOT RIVER & SHNONGPDENG VILLAGE
points: Enjoy breakfast and depart for Tyrna Village.
Upon reaching Tyrna, begin your trek to the Single Decker Living Root Bridge.
Continue the trek to the famous Double Decker Living Root Bridge.
Visit the beautiful Blue Lagoon Waterfall and enjoy swimming in its crystal-clear natural pool.
Trek back to Tyrna Village. (The trek involves approximately 3,300 steps one way, making it around 6,600 steps in total.)
After completing the trek, proceed back to Cherrapunjee.
Overnight stay in Cherrapunjee.

days.title: Cherrapunjee Sightseeing – Shillong
days.briefRoute: DAWKI TO SHILLONG VIA JOWAI | INDIA-BANGLADESH BORDER, PHE PHE WATERFALL & KRANG SURI FALLS
points: Enjoy breakfast and check out from your stay.
Visit the famous Mawsmai Cave and Arwah Cave.
Explore the beautiful Garden of Caves.
Witness the breathtaking Nohkalikai Falls and Seven Sisters Falls.
Visit Eco Park and enjoy the scenic views.
Later, proceed back to Shillong.
Check in to your stay and relax.
Overnight stay in Shillong.

days.title: Shillong – Guwahati Airport | Departure
days.briefRoute: DEPARTURE DAY | VISIT MAA KAMAKHYA TEMPLE & TRANSFER TO GUWAHATI
days.note: Note: It is advised to spend a maximum of 25–40 minutes at each sightseeing location to cover all the places mentioned in the itinerary.
points: Enjoy breakfast and check out from your stay.
Depart for Guwahati Airport around 9:00 AM.
The journey to the airport takes approximately 4–5 hours.
Expected arrival at the airport will be around 3:00 PM.
We recommend booking your return flight after 5:00 PM.
Bid farewell to your fellow travellers and take home beautiful memories from your incredible Meghalaya adventure. 💚
